Build succeeds cleanly with 0 warnings/errors. Let me verify my implementation logic against the spec once more for the key edge cases:

- **`RecordDelete`**: reads existing tombstone stamp (`-1` if absent); since stamps are non-negative, an absent entry (`-1 >= stamp`) is always false so it upserts, and only skips when an existing stamp is `>=` the new one. ✓
- **`SyncTwoWay`**: captures target-only names *before* any mutation (satisfying "as of the start"), processes source entries in file order (delete when `d >= max(s,t)` removing from each index present and counting each; else copy newer side), then target-only entries in target order. Tombstone is only read, never written. `mut` effect declared for the list. ✓
- **`SyncWithPolicy`**: dispatches to `SyncTwoWay` or `Sync` (which ignores the tombstone entirely). ✓

The task is complete. All three new operations (`RecordDelete`, `SyncTwoWay`, `SyncWithPolicy`) are implemented in `FolderSync.calr` following the existing conventions, the existing behavior is untouched, and the project builds cleanly.
